title: render_template reports any template compile/cache failure as "Prompt file ... not found", ending runs during condensation

labels.name: priority:medium
labels.description: For bugs, a serious source of annoyance, but not blocking a large number of users.

body:
_This issue was created by an AI agent (OpenHands) on behalf of @neubig._

## Summary

`openhands.sdk.context.prompts.prompt._get_template` catches **every** exception from Jinja's `get_template()` and replaces it with `FileNotFoundError("Prompt file <path> not found")`. So when a template file exists but cannot be compiled or cached, the user gets an error that says the file is missing. Examples: a Jinja syntax error, a decode error, or a failed write or read of the Jinja bytecode cache under `<OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR or ~/.openhands>/cache/jinja` (disk full, read-only or unwritable directory).

The condenser renders its packaged `summarizing_system.j2` template on every condensation, and this happens outside its error handling. A bytecode-cache I/O failure therefore ends the conversation run during message preparation with "Prompt file …/condenser/prompts/summarizing_system.j2 not found", even though the file is present. This happens even for a SOFT, event-count condensation, which would otherwise be skipped.

## Impact

- **Built-in templates:** if the disk is full or the Jinja cache directory cannot be written when the condenser first renders its template in a process, `run()` / `arun()` fail with `ConversationRunError` caused by `FileNotFoundError: Prompt file …/summarizing_system.j2 not found`. No model request is made. The error points to a missing or broken package, but the package is fine. The real cause is visible only in `__context__`. Each new attempt in the same process fails the same way, because `_get_template` only caches successes.
- **Custom templates** (`system_prompt_filename=` an absolute or custom path): a template with a syntax error is reported as "not found". The user goes looking for a path problem instead of the syntax error.
- **Missing custom template:** `Agent(...)` and `Conversation(...)` construct without error. The plain `FileNotFoundError` appears only at the first `send_message()` / `run()` (`init_state` → `static_system_message`), and again on every resume, because `init_state` re-renders the static prompt for restored conversations too.

## Root cause

All links are at [`af85e22`](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/tree/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b).

[`prompt.py#L59-L87`](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/context/prompts/prompt.py#L59-L87):

```python
@lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def _get_env(prompt_dir: str) -> Environment:
    cache_folder = get_user_persistence_dir() / "cache" / "jinja"
    cache_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bcc = FileSystemBytecodeCache(directory=str(cache_folder))
    env = Environment(loader=FlexibleFileSystemLoader(prompt_dir), bytecode_cache=bcc, ...)

@lru_cache(maxsize=256)
def _get_template(prompt_dir: str, template_name: str) -> Template:
    env = _get_env(prompt_dir)
    try:
        return env.get_template(template_name)
    except Exception:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Prompt file {os.path.join(prompt_dir, template_name)} not found"
        )
```

- `env.get_template()` compiles the template and then calls `FileSystemBytecodeCache.dump_bytecode()`. In Jinja 3.1 that creates a `NamedTemporaryFile` in the cache directory and re-raises any write error (`ENOSPC`, `EACCES`, …). It also raises `TemplateSyntaxError` / `UnicodeDecodeError` for a bad template. All of these become "not found". The real error is only kept as `__context__`, because there is no `from e`.
- The only real "missing" case is already handled by `FlexibleFileSystemLoader.get_source` (`TemplateNotFound`, [L34-L35](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/context/prompts/prompt.py#L34-L35)) and by the absolute-path check in `render_template` ([L107-L110](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/context/prompts/prompt.py#L107-L110)).

Why this ends a run during message preparation: `LLMSummarizingCondenser._generate_condensation` / `_agenerate_condensation` call `_build_summary_messages()`, which calls `render_template(prompt_dir, "summarizing_system.j2")` ([llm_summarizing_condenser.py#L209-L226](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/context/condenser/llm_summarizing_condenser.py#L209-L226)). That call happens *before* the `try` that turns summarizer failures into `NoCondensationAvailableException` ([L257-L266](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/context/condenser/llm_summarizing_condenser.py#L257-L266)). `RollingCondenser.condense` / `acondense` only catch `NoCondensationAvailableException` ([condenser/base.py#L163-L178](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/af85e224c9c0698e2b34efac4c27d254c64b151b/openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/context/condenser/base.py#L163-L178)). So the `FileNotFoundError` escapes `prepare_llm_messages` / `aprepare_llm_messages` and `Agent.step` / `astep`, even when the requirement was SOFT.

The packaged templates are present. The wheel ships `*.j2` as package data, and `agent-server.spec` collects `condenser/prompts/*.j2` and `prompts/templates/*.j2`; I checked that `collect_data_files` returns both. So resolving built-in templates differently would not fix this. The problem is how errors are classified.

## Reproduction

The templates and `prompt.py` are real and nothing in them is mocked. The full-disk case uses a real 2 MiB tmpfs. The run cases replace the LLM provider (`litellm_completion` / `litellm_acompletion`) with a function that fails the test if it is called, to show that no model request happens.

```bash
uv sync --dev --frozen
# optional, for the full-disk run test:
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/ohfull && sudo mount -t tmpfs -o size=2m tmpfs /mnt/ohfull
sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /mnt/ohfull
# save the file below as tests/sdk/context/test_prompt_not_found_repro.py
OH_FULL_DIR=/mnt/ohfull uv run pytest tests/sdk/context/test_prompt_not_found_repro.py -s -q -p no:cacheprovider
```

<details><summary>tests/sdk/context/test_prompt_not_found_repro.py</summary>

```python
"""Repro: render_template reports *any* template load/compile failure as
"Prompt file ... not found", even when the file exists.

The templates are the real packaged ones; nothing in prompt.py is mocked.
"""

import asyncio
import errno
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from pydantic import SecretStr

import openhands.sdk.context.condenser.llm_summarizing_condenser as cond_mod
import openhands.sdk.llm.llm as llm_mod
from openhands.sdk.agent import Agent
from openhands.sdk.context.condenser import LLMSummarizingCondenser
from openhands.sdk.context.prompts import prompt as prompt_mod
from openhands.sdk.context.prompts.prompt import render_template
from openhands.sdk.conversation import Conversation
from openhands.sdk.conversation.exceptions import ConversationRunError
from openhands.sdk.event import MessageEvent
from openhands.sdk.llm import LLM, Message, TextContent
from tests.sdk.context.view.conftest import (
    create_action_event,
    create_observation_event,
)


CONDENSER_PROMPTS = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(cond_mod.__file__), "prompts")
FULL_DIR = os.environ.get("OH_FULL_DIR")


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def fresh_jinja(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR", str(tmp_path / "oh"))
    prompt_mod._get_env.cache_clear()
    prompt_mod._get_template.cache_clear()
    yield
    prompt_mod._get_env.cache_clear()
    prompt_mod._get_template.cache_clear()


def _report(exc: BaseException, path: str) -> None:
    print(f"\n  file exists: {os.path.isfile(path)}")
    print(f"  raised: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    print(f"  __cause__: {exc.__cause__!r}  __context__: {exc.__context__!r}")


def test_malformed_custom_template_reported_as_missing(tmp_path):
    tpl = tmp_path / "custom_system_prompt.j2"
    tpl.write_text("You are helpful. {% if %}\n")
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError) as ei:
        render_template(str(tmp_path), str(tpl))
    _report(ei.value, str(tpl))
    assert tpl.is_file() and "not found" in str(ei.value)


@pytest.mark.skipif(os.getuid() == 0, reason="root ignores directory modes")
def test_unwritable_bytecode_cache_reported_as_missing(tmp_path):
    cache = tmp_path / "oh" / "cache" / "jinja"
    cache.mkdir(parents=True)
    cache.chmod(stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)  # read-only cache dir
    try:
        with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError) as ei:
            render_template(CONDENSER_PROMPTS, "summarizing_system.j2")
    finally:
        cache.chmod(stat.S_IRWXU)
    path = os.path.join(CONDENSER_PROMPTS, "summarizing_system.j2")
    _report(ei.value, path)
    assert os.path.isfile(path)


@pytest.mark.skipif(not FULL_DIR, reason="needs OH_FULL_DIR on a small tmpfs")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["sync", "async"])
def test_full_disk_condensation_ends_run_with_prompt_not_found(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, mode
):
    full = Path(FULL_DIR)
    for p in full.iterdir():
        p.unlink() if p.is_file() else None
    monkeypatch.setenv("OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR", str(full / f"oh-{mode}"))
    llm_calls = []

    def completion(*a, **k):
        llm_calls.append(k)
        raise AssertionError("LLM must not be reached")

    async def acompletion(*a, **k):
        return completion(*a, **k)

    monkeypatch.setattr(llm_mod, "litellm_completion", completion)
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm_mod, "litellm_acompletion", acompletion)

    llm = LLM(model="gpt-4o", api_key=SecretStr("k"), usage_id="a", num_retries=0)
    condenser = LLMSummarizingCondenser(
        llm=llm.model_copy(update={"usage_id": "c"}), max_size=20, keep_first=2
    )
    conv = Conversation(  # in-memory event store: only the jinja cache hits disk
        agent=Agent(llm=llm, tools=[], condenser=condenser),
        workspace=str(tmp_path),
        visualizer=None,
        stuck_detection=False,
    )
    conv._ensure_agent_ready()
    conv.state.append_event(
        MessageEvent(
            source="user",
            llm_message=Message(role="user", content=[TextContent(text="go")]),
        )
    )
    for i in range(15):  # 31 events > max_size=20 -> SOFT event-count condensation
        a = create_action_event(f"r{i}", f"c{i}")
        o = create_observation_event(f"c{i}", content=f"out {i}")
        conv.state.append_event(a)
        conv.state.append_event(o.model_copy(update={"action_id": a.id}))

    with open(full / "filler.bin", "wb") as f:  # disk is now full
        try:
            while True:
                f.write(b"\0" * 4096)
                f.flush()
        except OSError as e:
            assert e.errno == errno.ENOSPC
    try:
        with pytest.raises(ConversationRunError) as ei:
            conv.run() if mode == "sync" else asyncio.run(conv.arun())
    finally:
        (full / "filler.bin").unlink()
    path = os.path.join(CONDENSER_PROMPTS, "summarizing_system.j2")
    print(f"\n[{mode}] status={conv.state.execution_status.value} llm_calls={len(llm_calls)}")
    _report(ei.value.__cause__, path)
    assert isinstance(ei.value.__cause__, FileNotFoundError)
    assert os.path.isfile(path) and not llm_calls
```
</details>

Observed on `main` at `af85e22` (run as a non-root user):

```
test_malformed_custom_template_reported_as_missing
  file exists: True
  raised: FileNotFoundError: Prompt file /tmp/pytest-of-openhands/pytest-13/test_malformed_custom_template0/custom_system_prompt.j2 not found
  __cause__: None  __context__: TemplateSyntaxError("Expected an expression, got 'end of statement block'")
test_unwritable_bytecode_cache_reported_as_missing
  file exists: True
  raised: FileNotFoundError: Prompt file .../openhands/sdk/context/condenser/prompts/summarizing_system.j2 not found
  __cause__: None  __context__: PermissionError(13, 'Permission denied')
test_full_disk_condensation_ends_run_with_prompt_not_found[sync]
[sync] status=error llm_calls=0
  file exists: True
  raised: FileNotFoundError: Prompt file .../openhands/sdk/context/condenser/prompts/summarizing_system.j2 not found
  __cause__: None  __context__: OSError(28, 'No space left on device')
test_full_disk_condensation_ends_run_with_prompt_not_found[async]
[async] status=error llm_calls=0
  file exists: True
  raised: FileNotFoundError: Prompt file .../openhands/sdk/context/condenser/prompts/summarizing_system.j2 not found
  __cause__: None  __context__: OSError(28, 'No space left on device')
4 passed
```

Missing custom template (`Agent(llm=..., tools=[], system_prompt_filename="/tmp/rca/does_not_exist.j2")`): `Agent(...)` and `Conversation(...)` succeed. `send_message("hi")` then raises `FileNotFoundError: Prompt file /tmp/rca/does_not_exist.j2 not found` from `_ensure_agent_ready → init_state → static_system_message → render_template`.

## Expected behavior

- "not found" is reported only when the template file really does not exist (`TemplateNotFound`).
- A template syntax or decode error is reported as such, with the template path, and is not reported as "not found".
- A bytecode-cache I/O failure does not stop the template from rendering. The cache is an optimization: render without it, and log a warning.
- A failure to render the condenser's own prompt does not end a run when the condensation requirement is SOFT.
- (Nice to have) a missing custom `system_prompt_filename` is reported when the agent or conversation is configured, as a typed configuration error, and not only on the first message.

## Suggested fix

1. In `_get_template`, catch only `TemplateNotFound` and turn it into `FileNotFoundError(...) from e`. Let `TemplateSyntaxError`, `UnicodeDecodeError` and other errors propagate, or wrap them in a typed `PromptTemplateError(path) from e`.
2. Make the bytecode cache best-effort. Either subclass `FileSystemBytecodeCache` so that `dump_bytecode` / `load_bytecode` log `OSError` (and unpickling errors) and continue, or on such an error fall back to an `Environment` without `bytecode_cache`. Also handle a failing `cache_folder.mkdir`.
3. In `LLMSummarizingCondenser`, build the summary messages inside the existing `try` (or turn template errors into `NoCondensationAvailableException`). Then a SOFT requirement degrades to the unchanged view, and HARD goes through the normal fallback.
4. Optional: check that a custom `system_prompt_filename` exists in an `AgentBase` validator, or when `Conversation` is created.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `render_template` on an existing template with a Jinja syntax error raises an error that names the syntax problem (not "not found"), and keeps the original exception as `__cause__`.
- [ ] With the Jinja cache directory unwritable or the disk full, rendering `summarizing_system.j2` still returns the rendered prompt.
- [ ] With the same cache failure, a sync and an async conversation whose view needs SOFT condensation keep running (or condense), and do not end with `FileNotFoundError`.
- [ ] A template that really is missing still raises `FileNotFoundError` naming the path.
- [ ] (If item 4 is done) creating an agent or conversation with a missing custom `system_prompt_filename` fails with a typed configuration error before any model request. Fixing the path lets the next turn run.

Related: #7102 covers how the same full-disk condition breaks conversation state persistence. This issue is separate: here the template exists, and the failure is only in classifying errors and handling the Jinja cache.

## OpenHands AI triage
**The following comments and acceptance criteria were added by the OpenHands AI agent.**

### Triage
Verified against `main` at af85e22: `_get_template` converts every `env.get_template()` failure into `FileNotFoundError` without `from e`; `_get_env` performs an unprotected `mkdir` and always attaches a `FileSystemBytecodeCache` (jinja2 pinned at 3.1.6, whose cache write path re-raises `OSError`); `LLMSummarizingCondenser` builds summary messages before the `try` that raises `NoCondensationAvailableException`; `RollingCondenser.condense`/`acondense` catch only that exception; and `LocalConversation.arun` does not catch `FileNotFoundError`, so it ends the run as `ConversationRunError`. The repo's other `render_template` call sites (agent base, `AgentContext`, ask-agent) would get the corrected error classification centrally, but this issue is bounded to the failure modes and run-ending behavior described here.

Priority is `medium`, matching sibling issue #7102 from the same ENOSPC investigation (reproduced on `main`, but no external user report or production evidence in the issue or discussion).

**Non-goals:** construction-time validation of a missing custom `system_prompt_filename` (marked optional by the author; changes when configuration errors surface); the disk-full state persistence failure (tracked in #7102); new typed prompt error types or Jinja environment changes beyond best-effort cache handling; altering SOFT/HARD condensation semantics.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Rendering an existing template with a Jinja syntax error raises an exception that reports the syntax problem (not "not found"), includes the template path, and keeps the original exception as `__cause__`.
- [ ] A template that does not exist still raises `FileNotFoundError` naming the path.
- [ ] With the Jinja bytecode-cache directory unwritable or on a full disk, rendering the packaged `summarizing_system.j2` still returns the rendered prompt.
- [ ] When a cache directory cannot be created, `_get_env` either skips or degrades the bytecode cache instead of raising `FileNotFoundError`.
- [ ] With a render-time cache failure, sync and async conversations whose view has a SOFT condensation requirement complete their run without `ConversationRunError` caused by `FileNotFoundError`, and each render succeeds from then on (no repeated cache failure per attempt).
- [ ] A HARD condensation requirement still ends the run through the existing hard-context-reset path when rendering fails, preserving the original error in the exception chain (no new swallow behavior).
- [ ] Behavioral changes to `render_template`, `AgentContext`, agent base, or condensers are covered under the repository's SDK API-compatibility policy and by tests in the adjacent suites (`tests/sdk/context/`, condenser tests).
